shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
head with rendered facial features / headdress at top
incised or low-relief linear detailing over the body
circular / disc motif on the torso area
held or displayed object at chest level
symmetrical arrangement about a vertical axis
justification: Both surfaces present a single large frontal anthropomorphic figure filling the field, with a distinct head/headdress above, a decorated torso bearing a disc-like element and objects at chest level, arranged symmetrically about a vertical axis. However, the specific iconography differs sharply: B shows a winged, densely feathered figure with rosettes, hatched wing rows and a fine textual/panel area, while A shows a broad-shouldered figure with simple bold curvilinear motifs, a plain ring and a belt-like band, so the rendering conventions (dense fine hatching versus sparse bold contour) and the attributes are not shared.
